items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A green candidate served the marker and both fixture items received passing judge scores; the run passed and recorded the eleven specified effects in order, including gate-attempt-passed.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at the fence, a second start of R-1 for C-2 was refused run-already-started; the run list held only R-1 for C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: While R-1 was running its sleeping builder, R-2 was refused run-in-progress; progress showed R-1 running and R-2 absent.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 passed, R-2 for the same cycle was refused cycle-already-run, and R-2 progress was null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Started R-1 with a nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run refused not-a-commit, and run-progress returned null. No builder host was invoked.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: An empty plan produced a refused checklist with empty-checklist and halted before the self-check or fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A plan containing an unstamped scenario recorded its stamp, then halted at stamp because the identities differed, with no pin or checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A self-check printing golden checklist differs failed the cycle at the fence for harness-self-check-failed, but the recorded detail included a trailing newline and a fail-cycle effect followed the self-check, contrary to the stated last-effect Then.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The passing self-check printed SKIP bb-tools; its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed bb-tools.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Fencing an absent path refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, then recorded fail-cycle and failed at fence for fence-refused without a builder.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: The builder observed one root commit and one commit, with fenced paths absent from the object graph; the non-fenced gitlink retained mode 160000 and the cut’s identical object ID.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A red first candidate and green repair launched two builder sessions with distinct identities; regenerate completed before the first gate and subsequent repair launch.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder left a green candidate and exited 1; regenerate recorded its digest and the run passed.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: An empty successful builder launch produced no regenerate effect; fail-cycle recorded candidate-not-regenerated and the cycle failed at regenerate.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder sleeping for 30 seconds under a two-second regenerate budget was stopped; the cycle failed at regenerate for budget.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A server already answered the configured port; three gate refusals each produced gate-refusal, then the cycle failed for infrastructure and the launch sentinel was absent.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The red suite recorded suite-red, never launched start.sh, and exhausted the one gate attempt.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A candidate without start.sh recorded a gate-attempt-failed event for contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A green suite served a page without the configured marker; with one allowed attempt the gate recorded identity-probe-failed.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The builder changed its test.sh to fail after exit; the gate’s copy retained the passing test, the gate passed, and install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: The repair builder saw the clean room, previous candidate and gate evidence; attempted writes to the latter two were denied. Its repair event named the first gate’s evidence root.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Three red candidates caused three builder launches and three failed gates; the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted, without a verdict-file effect or researcher requests.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The common researcher code failed for 01-002 and scored 01-001; file-verdicts held only 01-001, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist; after five seconds both retained their statuses and identical effect results.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: Two reads of the passed run returned identical progress.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The probe accepted only one URL argument at the configured port and verified the marker; the gate and run passed.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The candidate suite created and removed a directory under its own scope; the gate passed and install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; its recorded event listed the entire text after SKIP.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With stdio selected and no port, the green suite, probe and store check passed; the gate event recorded 30 seconds, one poll answered on 1, and answered as the context, and the cycle passed without a refusal.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The probe received the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30, with GATE_STORE outside the gate room and no LOYLY_ variables; the store check received the same path.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A red stdio suite recorded suite-red; its environment had neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ variables, and neither probe nor store check ran.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The failing stdio probe produced identity-probe-failed with its boot-budget message; the store check did not run.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A passing probe and failing store check produced identity-probe-failed with the store-check message, exhausting the one attempt.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio suite checked for the plan spec beside it in its working tree; the gate passed and the install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: An absent stdio store-check command halted the run at gate for effect-could-not-run, without a gate result.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs with different store-check command texts recorded passing self-checks with different harness digests.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A symlinked plan slice stamped and derived 01-001 and 01-002 with sources under plan/01-a; the run continued and failed at the empty builder rather than halting.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With PLAN_SLICES=02, only slice 02 was stamped and the checklist contained only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Both builder launches received the configured image as the third argument; regenerate and repair details named the image and the same digest.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A configured missing builder image caused builder-image-missing; run-progress returned null and no builder was launched.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two runs passed on one store; C-2’s scoreboard named C-1 as previous, and its stamp recorded no new identity.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A probe read its marker beside itself at harness/config.sh and checked the served page; the gate passed and regenerate and install digests matched.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command gate ran once in the project repository with an empty candidate scope in the gate tree, a separately copied candidate matching the install digest, and an empty evidence directory. Its pass recorded BOOT 20 10, ANSWERED 3 and ledger answered as itself; the command did not launch the candidate.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The first gate command returned suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair saw its proof file read-only, and the second gate passed.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The gate command returned seam-answered-before-boot three times; each refusal was followed by gate-refusal, and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The gate command returned an unrecognized infrastructure line; progress halted at gate with effect-could-not-run and that detail, without a gate result, fail-cycle or cycle.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Three passing runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b had three distinct harness digests. The first matched the SHA-256 of configuration bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The green HTTP run passed and recorded the eleven expected effects. Grain’s reference event-store check confirmed each effect result lies in its named leaf of the run or a delegated child.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A server rejected its first three requests and the gate passed on poll 5 with a 20-poll budget. The run’s cycle progress attempt did not show the required boot-margin-polls of 15.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: A red first candidate and green repair passed on attempt 2. Grain shows two gate-attempt.v1 child ticks with each attempt’s install, self-check and gate in its own tick, and repair in the first; the reference event-store check confirmed named-leaf containment.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: A copy of the candidate under a temporary directory with no .pi ancestor ran the green HTTP fixture; attempt 1 and the cycle passed. The temporary copy was removed after profiling.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The two judges scored 01-001 pass/booked and 01-002 fail/no receipt; measurement filed 1 of 2 and the run passed. The store profile shows two distinct grade.v1 child traces of the run and two judge score events.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher returned E-ONE for 01-001 and E-TWO for 01-002. The first judge request held E-ONE, while the second researcher and judge requests did not.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher request carried the scenario, seam and event model; its shell reported Linux, the item grading room and only that room under its parent, with clean-room files and candidate copy.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The judge returned a reason for 01-001 and no reasoning for 01-002. Progress and the store showed one judge score, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: Started a run with approval r-1 and a different rubric-derived SHA-256 digest; progress halted at grader with refused-before-the-cycle and named the actual digest. Its effects stopped at checklist, with no self-check, fence, or builder launch.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher model returned HTTP 400 for both items. File-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the cycle failed at score without another builder launch.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: The runner and sleeping builder were stopped five seconds into the first session; restarting on the same store resumed and passed. Both builder launches carried the same session identity, and stamp, pin, checklist, first self-check, fence and regenerate each appeared once.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The builder recorded exactly INSTRUCTION-7 on its first launch; the repair instruction added only a closing paragraph naming the previous candidate and gate evidence paths.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: A model stub returned HTTP 400 for render; progress halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate or fail-cycle effect and no cycle. The builder host was not launched.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: While the builder slept, progress showed R-1 running with a tick identity, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate marked running.
